text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. sanctions committee on Iraq ratifies 34 contracts to supply Iraq with medicine.
- A foreign ministry spokesman says Iraq has given the U.N. envoy Rolf Ekeus a detailed report answering questions from the U.N. Special Commission on Iraq's chemical file.
- An Egyptian industrial delegation heads for Iraq.
- New French charge d'affaires to arrive in Baghdad on Sunday to assume his post as head of the French interest section.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Kurdish Legislative Council condemns a visit by U.S. officials to northern Iraq.
